_about: Window::mouse_up committed drag_endpoint to cpos without snapping. The endpoint was computed at mouse-down against an earlier buffer state; by mouse-up the transcript (readonly) had been re-laid-out by a resize and an interleaved thinking delta, so the stored byte offset landed mid-codepoint inside a '│' chrome glyph in the joined display text.
_fix: fix(edit): snap cpos in Window::mouse_up to text() / source()
